title: fix(multicursor): revert "]C"/"[C" cursor-plopping behavior
body:
Problem:
Jumping to a cursor adds one at the old position, so navigation has a side-effect. "]CQ" no longer deletes a cursor, and returning with "[C" after wandering off adds a cursor wherever you were.

This is useful in some cases, but as a default it is surprising. The default behavior should be simple and composable.

Solution:
Revert the "]C"/"[C" cursor-plopping behavior.
Document a mapping for the "rotate" behavior.

- ref https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/41664#issuecomment-5713472399
- reverts https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/41681
